title: Daal Masoor
steps: Boil red lentils with water and turmeric until soft.
Heat oil, fry cumin seeds, then add chopped onion and cook until golden.
Add garlic and ginger paste, fry for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and red chilli powder, cook until oil separates.
Add the boiled lentils, simmer 5 minutes and season with salt.

title: Aloo Gobi
steps: Heat oil and fry cumin seeds until they splutter.
Add sliced onion and cook until translucent.
Add diced potato and cauliflower florets, stir well.
Mix in spices, cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add chopped tomato, cook uncovered until dry.

title: Chicken Karahi
description: Classic Pakistani chicken cooked in a wok with tomatoes.
steps: Heat oil in a karahi, add cumin seeds.
Add chicken pieces and sear until white.
Add garlic and ginger, fry 2 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and all spices, cook until tomatoes break down.
Add yogurt, mix well and cook on medium heat until oil separates and chicken is cooked through.

title: Egg Fried Rice
description: Quick leftover rice stir-fry with eggs.
steps: Cook rice and let it cool completely (day-old rice works best).
Beat eggs and scramble in oil, set aside.
Fry onion and garlic in oil until golden.
Add rice, stir-fry on high heat.
Mix in scrambled egg, season with salt and serve.

title: Keema Aloo
steps: Fry onion in oil until dark golden.
Add garlic and ginger paste, cook 1 minute.
Add mince, break up lumps and cook until water dries.
Add spices and tomatoes, cook until oil surfaces.
Add cubed potato and 1/2 cup water, simmer covered until potatoes are tender.

title: Pasta in Tomato Sauce
description: Simple pasta with a quick homemade tomato sauce.
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente, reserve 1/4 cup pasta water.
Fry minced garlic in oil for 30 seconds.
Add chopped tomatoes, season with salt, simmer 10 minutes.
Toss pasta in the sauce, adding pasta water to loosen if needed.
